seo.title: Breastfeeding Tracker Help & Support
seo.description: Help using Breastfeeding Tracker on iPhone and Apple Watch, including timers, missed feeds, privacy, history and PDF export.

collection.name: Breastfeeding Tracker Help & Support
collection.description: Straightforward help for timing, correcting, reviewing, and exporting feeding history without schedules or medical advice.

hero.heading: How can we help?
hero.body: Straightforward help with recording feeds, correcting your history and using the app across iPhone and Apple Watch. If you cannot find what you need, email us and a real person will reply.

topics.label: Breast, bottle & pumping
topics.body: Keep breastfeeding, bottles, pumping and combined feeds together, including an expressed-milk balance.

topics.label: Getting started
topics.body: Start a breastfeeding timer, record the side and find the latest feed without filling in a form.

topics.label: Apple Watch
topics.body: Start and stop from your wrist, keep tracking offline and sync completed feeds back to iPhone.

topics.label: History & corrections
topics.body: Fix a late timer, add a missed feed and keep the record useful when the day gets interrupted.

topics.label: Privacy & exports
topics.body: Understand what stays private and create a PDF copy of selected feeding history.

contact.heading: Talk to a human.
contact.body: Tell us what is happening, which device you are using and what you expected to see. We read every support email.
contact.label: Email support
